mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.1% (as observed) indicates an extremely accommodative monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate of more than 0.3 percentage points signals a deteriorating labor market, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 0.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3 percentage points in a one-month period, it signals a deteriorating economic cycle that triggers risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% and UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) of more than 5% signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls by more than 5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 1.0% signals a strengthening economy, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises by more than 1.0% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in retail sales (RSAFS) of more than 2% signals a weakening consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS falls by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% (indicating extreme accommodation) and the unemployment rate is above 8.0% (indicating a weak labor market), it signals a recessionary environment that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 8.0%.
